Option Explicit
Dim f,s,p,log,n,c,where
Set f=CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
Set s=GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2")
Set log=f.CreateTextFile("C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\isolated-reset07.txt",True)
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
 n=n+1
 If p.ProcessId<>656 Or LCase(p.ExecutablePath)<>"c:\program files\spectra-physics\spitfire\spitfire.exe" Then log.WriteLine "Blocked identity": log.Close: WScript.Quit 10
Next
If n<>1 Then log.WriteLine "Blocked count": log.Close: WScript.Quit 11
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE ProcessId=656")
 log.WriteLine "Terminate only isolated harness original656 rc=" & p.Terminate()
Next
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='mshta.exe'")
 c=LCase(p.CommandLine)
 If InStr(c,"c:\spitfirelogs\run-2026-10-31-18-40-7-8660\app\run.hta")>0 And f.FileExists("C:\SpitfireLogs\run-2026-10-31-18-40-7-8660\result.json") Then log.WriteLine "Close completed logger pid=" & p.ProcessId & " rc=" & p.Terminate()
Next
log.WriteLine "No physical original PC/controller accessed; no panel close or warning button clicked."
log.Close
WScript.Quit 0
